summary: United Microelectronics Corp (UMC) filed a 6-K clarifying a media report that it is collaborating with Intel on 12nm and 3nm chip manufacturing, stating it does not comment on speculation. Separately, UMC disclosed the disposal of 3,500,832 common shares of Novatek Microelectronics at NTD 479.8/share (total NTD 1.68B) via conversion of zero-coupon exchangeable bonds due 2026, with a retained earnings impact of NTD 1.40B. The board did not separately resolve this transaction; terms follow the offering memorandum. No special-situation catalyst is present—this is a routine clarification and exchangeable bond conversion notification.
